name: Victor von Doom

summary: Victor was born in Latveria to a Romani family of the Zefiro clan, hunted by the soldiers of a cruel king. His father Werner was a healer; his mother Cynthia practised sorcery and struck a bargain with Mephisto that ended in her death when Victor was still small. Werner later died on the run after failing to save the dying queen, leaving the boy with two inheritances: a grudge against the crown and a trunk of his mother's occult tools. He taught himself both science and magic, and word of his genius eventually carried him to a scholarship at State University in the United States.

At college he met Reed Richards and nearly traded blows with Ben Grimm, but kept everyone at arm's length while secretly building a machine meant to reach his mother's soul in the netherworld. Reed spotted an error in the calculations; Victor refused to listen. The device exploded, leaving a scar on his face that his pride magnified into ruin, and the university expelled him. He blamed Reed for the rest of his life.

Drifting through Europe, Victor at last followed word of a hidden order of monks to the Himalayas, where he nearly died before reaching their temple. Within a few years he had outstripped his teachers, taken command of them and named himself Doctor Doom. The monks forged him a suit of armour, and he pressed the mask to his face before it had cooled. He then went home, raised a rebellion with robot troops, killed the king, renamed the capital Doomstadt and took the throne of Latveria.

comics.title: Birth of an archenemy
comics.summary: Doom bursts onto the scene by taking Sue Storm hostage and forcing the rest of the Fantastic Four to fetch treasure for him from the past with his Time Platform. In the very next issue he allies with Namor and drags the Baxter Building into space, then betrays his partner too. By the tenth issue he has learned to swap bodies with Reed Richards, in a story where he even holds Stan Lee and Jack Kirby hostage.

comics.title: Stealing the Power Cosmic
comics.summary: When the exiled Silver Surfer drifts into Latveria, Doom coaxes him into showing off his abilities and then drains them with a hidden device. Armed with the Surfer's board and cosmic might, he humbles the Fantastic Four and terrorises the planet. Reed lures him into chasing a device of his own design straight into the barrier Galactus had placed around Earth, and the collision strips the power away.

comics.title: King of Latveria
comics.summary: Doom lets the Fantastic Four sneak into Latveria, conditions them so their powers fail and keeps them as permanent honoured guests, then turns robot troops on his own restless subjects. He finally lets the team leave after killing an aide who endangered his art collection. Years later the team helps him win back his throne from Prince Zorba, and Doom adopts the orphan Kristoff Vernard as his heir.

comics.title: The first Secret Wars
comics.summary: Kidnapped by the Beyonder to fight on a patchwork planet, Doom takes charge of the villains. After their defeat he uses the body of Klaw to siphon power from Galactus, then steals the Beyonder's own power and becomes, briefly, a god who dares not sleep in case his dreams unmake reality. The Beyonder survives inside Klaw, tricks him into losing control, and takes everything back.

comics.title: Emperor, then penitent son
comics.summary: Doom amplifies the Purple Man's mind control to a global scale and has the world's governments crown him emperor, delivering peace and plenty at the price of free will, until his own boredom lets the Avengers wreck the machine. Two years later he teams with Doctor Strange to pull his mother's soul out of Mephisto's realm. The rescue works only because she comes to despise her son, a cost he accepts.

comics.title: Unthinkable
comics.summary: Having saved Sue Richards during a dangerous birth and named her daughter Valeria, Doom sacrifices the original Valeria, his first love, to a trio of demons in exchange for vast magical power. He wears armour made from her skin, traps Franklin Richards in hell and toys with a powerless Fantastic Four. Reed learns enough magic to turn the tables, and Doom's demonic patrons drag him down to hell.

comics.title: From the Cabal to the Children's Crusade
comics.summary: Iron Man's Mighty Avengers storm Latveria and arrest Doom for crimes against humanity, interrupting a time-spanning affair with Morgan le Fay that he was using to learn dark magic. Soon free, he takes a seat on Norman Osborn's Cabal while refusing to take Osborn's orders. He is later revealed to have helped push the Scarlet Witch's power to breaking point, and he steals that power himself until it overloads.

comics.title: Rabum Alal and God Emperor Doom
comics.summary: Doom learns the multiverse is dying by design, spends years as the feared figure Rabum Alal, and finally kills the Beyonders with Doctor Strange and the Molecule Man, stealing their power. When reality collapses he stitches the surviving fragments into Battleworld and rules it as God Emperor, even living with a version of Sue Storm and her children. Reed Richards returns to challenge him, the Molecule Man hands the power to Reed, and Reed rebuilds the multiverse, healing Doom's scars along the way.

comics.title: Infamous Iron Man
comics.summary: Left hollow by godhood, Victor decides to try the opposite of conquest. He steps down from his throne, offers help to Tony Stark, and after Stark falls into a coma takes up the Iron Man name himself. Mephisto torments him with an illusion of his mother while S.H.I.E.L.D. hunts him for old crimes, but by the end he has begun to earn a little trust.

comics.title: One World Under Doom
comics.summary: When vampires blot out the sun, Doom extracts the title of Sorcerer Supreme from Doctor Strange to save the world, then twists the terms and keeps it. Soon every world leader swears loyalty to Emperor Doom, who promises an end to war plus health care and schooling for all. The heroes expose that he has been harvesting his own people's souls for power, but he still locks his rule into a fixed point in reality, and the blast kills his goddaughter Valeria Richards.

screen.title: Fantastic Four
screen.summary: Here Victor is a billionaire industrialist and Reed Richards' old college rival who bankrolls the space mission and rides along. The cosmic storm gives him command of electricity and slowly turns his body to living metal, and he puts on the mask once his face is ruined. The united Fantastic Four freeze him solid, and his metal body is shipped back to Latveria.

screen.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
screen.summary: The Silver Surfer's passing energy frees Doom after two years as a metal statue, and a blast from the Surfer heals his body. He talks his way into a deal with the US military, then seizes the Surfer's board and its power for himself. In Shanghai, Johnny Storm channels the whole team's powers to break his hold, and Ben Grimm knocks him into the harbour with a crane.

screen.title: Fantastic Four
screen.summary: This Victor is a gifted, resentful scientist who helps build the Quantum Gate and joins an unauthorised jump to the dimension called Planet Zero, where he is left for dead. Fused to his suit and gifted with telekinesis, he returns a year later calling himself Doom, kills Franklin Storm and tries to pull Earth into a black hole. The new team beats him together, and Ben Grimm punches him into the collapsing portal.

screen.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
screen.summary: Doom appears only in the mid-credits scene, set four years after the main story on Earth-828. Sue Storm steps away from reading to young Franklin and returns to find a cloaked figure on the couch, who kneels and removes his mask in front of the boy as Sue readies her powers behind him. The film page lists Downey as Victor von Doom/Doctor Doom for that scene; the Doom character page notes he was uncredited.

screen.title: Avengers: Endgame (Encore re-release)
screen.summary: According to the MCU Wiki, the Avengers Endgame: Encore re-release of 25 September 2026 adds post-credits material featuring Doom. He materialises in Bruce Banner's sealed underground lab at Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling, says he has come to collect him, forces the change into Hulk and teleports them both away, leaving green runes behind. A further scene shows him forging his armour and mask on Earth-828.

unverified: The 1994 Fantastic Four film (Joseph Culp as Doom) is left out because the Marvel Fandom wiki lists it as never released.
Avengers: Doomsday (listed for 18 December 2026) is left out because it has not been released yet. No plot details were researched.
The Endgame Encore entry rests only on the MCU Wiki's account of a September 2026 re-release. No other allowed source was checked against it.
MCU Wiki pages disagree on credit for First Steps: the film page lists Downey in the cast for the mid-credits scene, while the Doctor Doom page says he was uncredited. Both are reported as written.

Retellings disagree on details such as Doom's age when his mother died and how long he spent with the monks (Fantastic Four Annual #2 vs Books of Doom). The origin summary keeps to the shared outline.
